thread:
mike: Heads up — deploy-bot is proposing a runtime pin for runtime-v3.2. Reason: observed model mismatch for llama3q-quant during canary. Should we accept or override? cc: @sarah @eva

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Pin suggestion: runtime-v3.2 -> hold rollout. Details: regressions in kvcache under longseq on eu-west canary. Suggested action: soft-pin until QA sign-off. See logs: https://internal/deploy/logs/3350012345

sarah: Do we have telemetry snapshots? what signal tripped exactly?

mike: 12% increase in median latency on longseq (16k+ tokens), error rate +0.3% on reranks. Telemetry: https://internal/telemetry/3350 (early morning windows)

eva: I ran a quick diff — kernel mismatch on fused-attn fallback. Looks like quant kernel selection flips for seq > 8192, causing slower path. cc @ryan

ryan: on it. I'll pull the kernel selection matrix and repro locally. If we can force kernel A for this model-group we can avoid a pin, but that needs a tiny runtime shim (hotpatch). Risky at 03:00 PT.

ben: from customer ops: dedicated customers might see a blip if we move forward. We should avoid touching Dedicated pools in the night. Happy to draft a notice if we pin hosted only.

mike: Ops question — if we override pin, do we have an automatic rollback plan? @deploy-bot what's the rollback trigger?

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Rollback trigger configured: if error_rate > 0.25% OR p99 latency +200ms sustained for 5m, rollback to runtime-v3.1 and reroute canary traffic. Manual override: `/deploy toggle rollback 3350012345`.

sarah: Given the night window and customer impact, my vote: accept a soft-pin for hosted only, do NOT change Dedicated. We can schedule the hotpatch in the morning for hosted. Need a runbook for monitoring and clear owner.

eva: Agree with Sarah. I'll draft a short runbook and add monitoring queries. I'll also exclude EU edge nodes on the pin if possible.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll approve the pin for hosted now.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Applied soft-pin: hosted -> runtime-v3.1 for model-group=llama3q-quant. Expires in 6h unless extended. Requester: mike.

ryan: I'll keep prototyping the shim; if it's low-risk I'll push for a fastpath hotpatch tomorrow morning and notify this thread.

ben: I'll prepare a short customer note for enterprise accounts and post to #customer-notify once reviewed. Ping me for edits.

sarah: Runbook (draft): https://internal/playbooks/pin-3350012345 — includes monitoring queries, escalation steps, and rollback commands.

mike: Thanks all. I'll close the loop once we're past the 6h window. Reopen this thread if telemetry trips the rollback trigger or shim is ready.
